 Who are we looking for? 
 GHD is currently seeking an Intern to work with our groups on projects related to environmental remediation and natural resources services. This position is a paid internship position. Our teams work with a wide range of public and private sector clients across Atlantic Canada to support sustainable infrastructure, environmental stewardship, and community development. 
The objective of GHD’s Internship Program is to provide students who self-identify as members of Indigenous communities the opportunity to gain experience in a consulting environment and contribute to a range of infrastructure and environmental projects. The program is intended to provide meaningful professional experience, mentorship, and exposure to the types of work delivered by multidisciplinary consulting teams.

 BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. Further information is available at www.bgis.com 
 SUMMARY 
 The HVAC Apprentice/Journeyperson holds a valid Certificate of Qualification issued by the province in which the work is performed. The incumbent is responsible for operating facility systems, performing preventative and corrective maintenance, routine services on facility mechanical and other systems for the assigned facility within the limits of company policy and trade certification. The HVAC Journeyperson is also responsible for performing work in accordance with established processes and practices and for complying with internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, security and fire protection.
